pages.text: Each day after class, Julia and Toby sneak off to the wood.
pages.picture: the girl and the dragon sneaking into the woods in the afternoon

pages.text: "I bet floating is like feelings," said Julia. "When you get upset, things zoom up. So let's start there."
pages.picture: the girl explaining like a teacher, the dragon listening in a woodland clearing

pages.text: "Toby, lift up that tin can." Toby looks at the can. He huffs. He puffs. Not a thing.
pages.picture: the dragon straining to stare at a tin can on a tree stump

pages.text: Toby gets cross. And the can zooms up, up, up, and lands in a tree!
pages.picture: a tin can flying up into a tall tree, the dragon cross

pages.text: "Now that stick," said Julia. Toby looks hard at the stick.
pages.picture: the dragon staring hard at a stick on the ground

pages.text: The stick shoots up and bonks Julia on the chin! "Ow! Toby!"
pages.picture: a stick bonking the girl on the chin, comic

pages.text: Toby droops. "I am no good at this," he said.
Day after day, it is the same. Cans zoom off. Sticks smash. Not one thing floats the right way.
pages.picture: a montage of cans and sticks flying everywhere in the woods
